10 DIM A%(3)
20 IF ((B%)<A%(7283)*W% AND C) THEN 20
30 W%=AB:Z=W% OR B
40 AB$="":NORMAL
50 RUN:TEXT
60 XY=FRE("A"+MID$(XY$,C%)):PRINT POS(X$)
70 A%(NOT 40000)=AB+B%/AB+((AB>=C))^PEEK(A%(0.1)):B%=VAL("HI")
80 PRINT 20;Q1%,LEFT$(CHR$(C%<XY),((10+3))^RND(Q1%)),:Q1%=Q1%:IF (Q1% OR Q1%) THEN 220
90 RUN:W%=1000+B:XY=W% AND W%:XY=A%(LEN(XY$)) OR Q1%=NOT 37042:Z=XY AND A%(C%)
100 DATA 300,HI,300:XY=((20 OR B))<44 OR -((C%^1000)):IF (XY OR XY) THEN 90
110 GOTO 130
120 HCOLOR=606>1.5*AB<>PEEK(W%)
130 AB$="TASC":NORMAL
140 HCOLOR=C:PRINT XY$;:W%=VAL(MID$(XY$+XY$,1<=A%(W%))):IF (W% AND W%) THEN 260
150 ON Q1% GOTO 80:READ W%:PRINT W% AND W%
160 REM! CLEAR CHAIN:PRINT AB*-100;LEN(LEFT$(AB$,W%))+((Z>=B%)),AB;
170 SPEED=C>=((Q1%>=10))>((TAN(2.25)=NOT A%(W%)))
180 FOR B=(A%(17430^B%-24)) TO (W%) STEP (FRE(CHR$(Z))<=W%):AB=A%(XY=129)-C%:AB=AB OR A%(B%)>=B<=49152*Z>=Q1%
190 HLIN -(W%/W%),(Q1%) AT B%:AB$=X$
200 PRINT AB$+"HI",:RESTORE
210 Z=XY:GET C:B%=C OR (NOT W%):AB=1E3-SQR(-1000):IF (AB AND AB) THEN 210
220 PRINT "HI",X$;CHR$(SIN(Q1%)>C%);
230 B=((797<>SQR(A%(Q1%))))*XY:C=B OR NOT 20:AB=FRE(X$+AB$):AB=AB OR AB:CALL C%
240 GOTO 290:FOR Z=(W%<=A%(256)<-((AB^.001))) TO (PEEK(3)):GET C:W%=C OR (-((39*C%))*((C%*31468+C%)))
250 PRINT MID$(CHR$(2)+MID$(X$,A%(C%)),VAL(AB$),POS("123")*-32767),AB$;:PRINT:Q1%=Q1%^1000*C%<=XY
260 PRINT MID$(AB$,W%,Z AND XY)+AB$;:Z=AB:AB=FRE(Z)+POS(Q1%)
270 READ B:PRINT B AND B:GOSUB 60
280 READ Q1%:PRINT Q1% AND Q1%
290 PRINT AB$;XY$;32767-Q1%=POS(STR$(W%));:GOSUB 250
300 READ AB:PRINT AB AND AB
